rules.entry: Fresh quotes with 20 observations; close > EMA(slow)*(1+band), EMA(slow) rising versus 5 sessions earlier. Recover only after 3 consecutive healthy closes. No universe breadth veto.
rules.exit: Stock closes below EMA(slow)*(1-band); or optional overheat reversal where previous close > previous EMA(slow)*1.30 and one-day loss>3% or three-day loss>6%. Overheat lock 10 sessions. Flat-state alarms do not refresh locks.
rules.ownership: Review every 20 sessions or after a holding becomes invalid; raw log-momentum weights .2/.4/.4 for 20/slow/2*slow sessions, incumbent additive .05 preference. Hold units, allocate material idle cash, no upward-volatility penalty and no aggregate NAV-based automatic stop.
rules.risk: Cash budget is 1 but only eligible stocks receive allocations; zero eligible means cash. Required liquidity, minimum lots, opening-limit approximations, fees and slippage unchanged. Close decisions execute next open.

selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / same_engine_buy_hold_wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20)); ties fewer fills then smaller candidate index
interpretation: Fifth authorized retrospective family; includes lessons from prior failed studies, not an independent untouched validation. Preserve every prior and current candidate and failure. Same economics, initial cash, data and costs; no stock-name or date overrides. Selected candidate still needs subset, cost, delay and native-reference comparability checks.
